'''Aridinian folk music''' was a traditional form of [[Music/Legends|music]]<ref name="RF:U" /> that was created in the [[Aridinia system/Legends|Aridinia system]].<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=Aridinian folk music|system=[[Aridinia system/Legends|Aridinia system]]|legends=1}}</ref> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' states that the events of ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> it had become famous across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for its ability to make [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ear/Legends|ears]] bleed after a few notes.<ref name="RF:U" /> The music was thereby regulated outside of its native [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Music">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> In 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] broadcast a recording of the [[Aridinian]] music as a distraction, allowing his [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|companions]]&mdash;[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]&mdash;to [[Battle of the Sixela system|escape]] from the rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]]. However, another of R2-D2's compatriots, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], stayed behind to continue his masquerade as Soresh's [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]].<ref name="RF:U" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aridinian folk music first appeared in ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]'', the sixth novel of the ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'' series. It was authored by [[Alex Wheeler]] and published in [[2010]].<ref name="RF:U" />
